source.section: Form M1 lines 1-4, 7-10 (instructions PDF p.13 Standard Deduction Table for Line 4, p.14 Worksheet A, p.39 Tax Rate Schedules, pp.32-38 tax table); Schedule M1R lines 1-13 and Line 10 table (M1R PDF p.1, p.2); Form M1 instructions PDF p.15; M1M PDF p.5 line 16; Schedule M1M line 1 (M1M PDF p.3 'Line 1 - Interest From Municipal Bonds of Another State')

worked: Head of household: 9,600 and 14,500, age box 2,000. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution 20,000.00 = 20,000.00. Federal taxable income = 20,000.00 - 25,625.00 federal standard deduction (23,625 plus 1 x 2,000) = below zero, so 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form M1, head of household: line 1 federal AGI 20,000.00. Schedule M1M line 1 other-state municipal interest 20,000.00; line 10 additions 20,000.00; Form M1 line 2 20,000.00; line 3 = 40,000.00. Schedule M1R: line 1 9,600.00; line 2 0.00 (65 or older); line 3 9,600.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 nontaxable Social Security 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; line 6 Railroad Retirement Board benefits 0.00; line 7 0.00; line 8 = 9,600.00. Line 9 20,000.00; line 10 14,500.00; line 11 5,500.00; line 12 2,750.00; line 13 = 6,850.00. Schedule M1M line 40 = Form M1 line 7 subtractions = 0.00 + 6,850.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 6,850.00 (lines 12, 16, 17, 25). State income before deduction = 40,000.00 - 6,850.00 = 33,150.00. Standard Deduction Table for Line 4 (PDF p.13): base 22,500.00 plus 1 x 2,000 age box(es) = 24,500.00; AGI is not over 238,950.00, so no Worksheet A. Line 4 = 24,500.00. Form M1 line 8 total = 24,500.00 + 6,850.00 = 31,350.00; line 9 Minnesota taxable income = 40,000.00 - 31,350.00 = 8,650.00. Line 10 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.39): 5.35% x (8,650.00 - 0.00) = 462.775 = 462.775. The tax table (PDF pp.32-38) gives 463; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 16 credits 0.00; state income tax 462.78.
accepted_approximations: Tax comes from the rate schedules at every income; below 86,800 of taxable income the booklet requires its 100-wide tax table.
